From: Eli Torres <eli.torres@atlaspay.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request after self-serve signup

Thanks Marcus — I signed up via the self-serve flow last week and ran a quick pilot with one of our ingestion pipelines. We're interested in a dedicated capacity conversation because we need predictable latency and sustained throughput for a customer-facing fraud detection feature.

High-level constraints: roughly 120 concurrent sessions, peak steady-state ~150 requests/sec, typical prompt length ~450 tokens, expected KV cache reuse across sessions (lots of shared prefixes). Our SRE asked for a 95th percentile tail latency target of <=200ms for typical queries.

Could we schedule a short technical demo focused on dedicated capacity sizing + latency tradeoffs? Ideally sometime today or tomorrow afternoon PST. Also looped in procurement (procurement@atlaspay.com) for timeline visibility — they'll want an initial SOW and SOC2 info.

Thanks,
Eli Torres
Head of Platform Integrations
AtlasPay

Hi Eli — great to meet you over email. Marcus routed this to me to get a demo on the calendar and to capture any immediate sizing details. We can absolutely cover dedicated capacity sizing, latency profiles, and KV/prefix caching behavior in a focused 45-minute session.

Quick ask so we come prepared: can you confirm your expected RPS distribution (is 150 rps a sustained peak or burst?), the percentage of requests that hit the same prefix (estimating cache hit rate helps us recommend batching/replica counts), and whether encrypted-at-rest/on-prem key management is required for the initial POC?

We have availability today 3:00–4:30pm PST and tomorrow 11:00am–2:00pm PST. I can shoot a calendar invite once you confirm a slot.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference

Hi Eli — thanks for the detail. 3:00pm PST today works on our side and Ben will send the calendar invite in a minute. I attached the demo-prep-runbook.md that outlines the synthetic load script (we use a configurable qps profile), the sample prompt set, and what to watch in the Console dashboards (per-route latency, token breakdown).

A few prep notes so the demo is targeted:
- For a 150 rps steady target with 450-token prompts, we'll likely recommend a small pool of 4–6 GPUs depending on SKU (A10G-equivalent vs A100-equivalent makes a difference). If you need sub-200ms 95p at that scale we may suggest dedicated replicas + lower batching horizons and KV-aware replica routing.
- If the prefix reuse is >40%, KV caching can dramatically reduce compute and reduce tail latency — please bring a sample prompt or a short prefix list if possible.
- If you need KMS/HSM integration for keys, procurement should flag it now because private deployment options have longer lead times.

Ben — please include a short link to our SOC 2 report in the invite and mark the meeting as "tight technical demo — please bring SRE or an engineer". Eli / procurement: welcome to the invite, you can replace the calendar with a different slot if needed.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
